description: A grumpy, slightly gruff middle-aged Polish market merchant in his forties or fifties speaking Polish with a natural standard Polish accent: comic but natural, a hungry grumbler who warms up and laughs heartily.
text: Za darmo? Od rana tu stoję i nic nie jadłem… Za obwarzanka bym dał! Szewczyk na smoka? Ha ha ha! Patrz… on naprawdę zrobił owcę!
